```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
## Persistence-point simulation driver.
##
## Contract:
##   - Use posterior demographic draws from script 1.
##   - Use the optimized C++ common-random-number simulator.
##   - Write tidy persistence-point tables for script 3.
##   - Keep expensive simulation settings centralized and explicit.

source("R/persist_config.R")

RUN_MAMMALS <- isTRUE(params$run_mammals)
RUN_BIRDS <- isTRUE(params$run_birds)
VERBOSE <- isTRUE(params$verbose)

message(describe_persist_params(params, "R Markdown params"))

SIM <- list(
  quasi_extinction_abundance = quasi_extinction_abundance(),
  years = persistence_horizon_years(),
  cap_factor = as.numeric(params$cap_factor),
  r_buffer = as.numeric(params$r_buffer),
  n_draws = as.integer(params$n_draws),
  reps = as.integer(params$reps),
  chunk_size = as.integer(params$chunk_size),
  base_seed = as.integer(params$base_seed)
)

GRID <- list(
  q_levels = persistence_quantiles(),
  p_anchor = as.numeric(params$p_anchor),
  p_grid = c(
    seq(
      as.numeric(params$p_grid_lower),
      as.numeric(params$p_grid_upper),
      by = as.numeric(params$p_grid_step)
    ),
    as.numeric(params$p_grid_extra)
  ),
  k_search = list(
    start_k = as.numeric(params$k_search_start_k),
    rel_tol = as.numeric(params$k_search_rel_tol),
    round_k = isTRUE(params$k_search_round_k)
  )
)

PATHS <- list(
  mammal_mass_grid = params$mammal_mass_grid,
  bird_mass_grid = params$bird_mass_grid,
  bird_ilr_coords = params$bird_ilr_coords,
  post_m_rm = params$post_m_rm,
  post_m_sigma = params$post_m_sigma,
  post_b_rm = params$post_b_rm,
  post_b_sigma = params$post_b_sigma,
  cpp_file = params$cpp_file,
  rcpp_cache = params$rcpp_cache,
  results_dir = params$results_dir,
  mammals_points = params$mammals_points,
  birds_points = params$birds_points
)

load_persist_packages()
source("R/persist_inputs.R")
source("R/persist_simulation.R")

validate_persist_config(params, SIM, GRID)

inputs <- load_persist_inputs(PATHS, params, SIM)
CRN_CTX <- create_crn_context(SIM)

if (isTRUE(params$run_crn_self_test)) {
  run_crn_self_test(SIM)
}

message(
  "Setup OK | RUN_MAMMALS=", RUN_MAMMALS,
  " RUN_BIRDS=", RUN_BIRDS,
  " n_draws=", SIM$n_draws,
  " reps=", SIM$reps,
  " years=", SIM$years,
  " bird_combos=", if (RUN_BIRDS) nrow(inputs$birds$ilr) else 0L
)
```

```{r run_mammals}
if (RUN_MAMMALS) {
  log_msg("MAMMALS | start", flush = VERBOSE)

  run_one_scenario(
    masses_g = inputs$mammals$mass,
    sampler = make_mammal_sampler(inputs$mammals, SIM),
    out_file = PATHS$mammals_points,
    crn_ctx = CRN_CTX,
    combo = NA_character_,
    sim = SIM,
    grid = GRID,
    append = FALSE,
    verbose = VERBOSE
  )

  validate_points_schema(
    PATHS$mammals_points,
    "mammal persistence points",
    min_k = SIM$quasi_extinction_abundance
  )

  log_msg("MAMMALS | wrote: ", PATHS$mammals_points, flush = VERBOSE)
  log_msg("MAMMALS | done", flush = VERBOSE)
} else {
  log_msg("MAMMALS | skipped because params$run_mammals is FALSE", flush = TRUE)
}
```

```{r run_birds}
if (RUN_BIRDS) {
  log_msg("BIRDS | start", flush = VERBOSE)

  bird_combos_all <- inputs$birds$ilr[order(combo), as.character(combo)]

  run_bird_combo_set(
    combo_ids = bird_combos_all,
    bird_inputs = inputs$birds,
    paths = PATHS,
    sim = SIM,
    grid = GRID,
    crn_ctx = CRN_CTX,
    force = isTRUE(params$force_rerun_bird_combos),
    verbose = VERBOSE
  )

  combo_counts <- finalize_bird_output(inputs$birds, PATHS, GRID)
  print(combo_counts)
  validate_points_schema(
    PATHS$birds_points,
    "bird persistence points",
    min_k = SIM$quasi_extinction_abundance
  )

  log_msg("BIRDS | canonical output written: ", PATHS$birds_points, flush = VERBOSE)
  log_msg("BIRDS | done", flush = VERBOSE)
} else {
  log_msg("BIRDS | skipped because params$run_birds is FALSE", flush = TRUE)
}
```

```{r output_summary}
outputs <- data.table::data.table(
  output = c("mammal persistence points", "bird persistence points"),
  path = c(PATHS$mammals_points, PATHS$birds_points),
  requested_this_run = c(RUN_MAMMALS, RUN_BIRDS)
)
outputs[, exists := file.exists(path)]
outputs[, size_mb := ifelse(exists, round(file.info(path)$size / 1024^2, 3), NA_real_)]
print(outputs)
```
